rationale: S-0018-03 proposes implementing AMPA + NMDA + GABA_A synapses with E-I temporal co-tuning and SAC-to-DSGC asymmetric inhibition in the downstream DSGC model. AMPA + GABA_A done in t0052/t0053; AMPA + NMDA + GABA done in t0054; SAC-to-DSGC asymmetric (centripetal) inhibition done in t0053. The remaining piece - explicit E-I temporal co-tuning (i.e., per-synapse E and I onset times offset by a direction-dependent delta) - is not covered by t0053's identical-onset-time scheme and not currently on the critical path. The temporal co-tuning piece belongs in a future fresh suggestion that can specify the exact protocol; the original S-0018-03 is too broad to act on now. Rejecting; future fresh suggestion will replace it if needed.
